welcome.eyebrow: A one-time desktop tool · No account · No subscription
welcome.h1:
You don't need
a business plan.
You need one idea.
welcome.lead: Answer 5 short questions. Get 3 businesses you can actually start with the money, time and skills you already have — plus a one-page plan you can print and follow tomorrow.
welcome.never_leave: Your answers never leave this device
welcome.mock_desc: Help 20 neighbourhood shops answer Google reviews with a fixed template pack.
welcome.foot: Built for people who want to start small and start today.
quiz.lead: No sign-up, no typing an essay. Everything stays on this computer.
quiz.note1_p: Your answers are used locally to pick ideas and are never uploaded. No account, no email, no tracking.
quiz.note2_p: Because 30 ideas is just homework. Three that actually fit you is a decision.

detail.channels_h: Where the first customers come from
detail.pitfalls_h: Three ways people get this wrong
detail.paper_note: A printable PDF with the cost table, 7 steps, pricing and first-customer channels. Generated on this device, saved wherever you choose.
export.lead: One PDF, one page, no watermark. It's a file on your disk — not a link, not an account, not something that can expire.
export.inside_p: Cost breakdown · pricing hint · 7 steps · first-customer channels · 3 pitfalls · local note.
export.extras_p: Also export the cost table as CSV for your own spreadsheet. Still local, still yours.
saved.lead: Saved locally. No cloud, no sync, no login — open the app six months later and they're still here.
saved.empty: Nothing saved yet. Find three ideas and keep the ones you like.
saved.foot: Made your first sale? Come back and run the 5 questions again with a bigger budget. Same button, same 3 cards.
saved.confirm_p: Your saved ideas will be removed from this device. Nothing is deleted from the idea library — you can always find them again.
library.lead: The tool checks once a month for new ideas. If it can't reach the internet, nothing happens — every idea already on your device keeps working.
library.tl1_p: +14 new ideas: setting up simple AI agents for local shops, monthly care plans, no-code upkeep. Older mobile-era ideas gently move down.
library.tl2_p: +18 ideas using off-the-shelf AI tools with almost no startup cost.
library.tl3_p: +11 ideas, 3 retired after platform changes. Nothing was deleted from your disk.
library.tl4_p: Frozen copy. Complete and usable forever, even with no internet at all.
library.how_p: On the 1st, a tiny file (a few KB) is downloaded: a handful of new ideas, a few revisions, and occasional retirements. Your local copy is merged in place. There is no server running your ideas — the thinking has always been on your machine.
library.why_h: Why new ideas keep showing up
library.why_p: A business idea has a season. Mobile-internet ideas made sense in one era; AI and agent ideas make sense in the next. The library should follow the world, not freeze at the day you bought it. Fresh ideas float up; saturated ones quietly sink — never vanish.
library.toast: Library checked · you're up to date. No action needed.
activate.eyebrow: For copies bought outside the stores
activate.lead: Store downloads are already activated — you'll never see this screen. This page is only for copies bought on other software marketplaces.
activate.code_hint: It arrived in your receipt email right after payment.
activate.seats_hint: One code works on up to 3 of your own devices.
activate.notice: Activation is not a login. Once verified, a small signed file is kept on this device. After that the tool works with the internet off — we never check again.
activate.why_p: An installer file can be copied. The code simply proves this copy was paid for. It is not about trust in you — it's about a file that can be forwarded.
settings.lead: Everything here is local. No profile, no password, nothing to sync.

settings.crash_d: Off by default. No answers, no ideas, no files.
settings.privacy_h: Your answers, your saved ideas and your exported plans never leave this device.
settings.privacy_p: The only outbound request is "is there a newer idea file?" once a month. It carries no user data. Turn it off and the tool is 100% offline, forever.
